setup: A non-production account under accounts/<domain>/ with profile.json, the Support module enabled, at least one case type, and a test contact <contact-email>. Replace the placeholders with real test values from that account.

evals.prompt: Open a support ticket for <contact-email>: 'Printer does not turn on'.
evals.expected_output: Maps the request to Ticket, reads /v2/openapi/specification/ticket, finds the contact's _id (and a case type if required), summarizes the ticket, waits for a yes, creates it with references as _id strings, and reads it back.
expectations: Reads the object's own OpenAPI entry (not the full specification) before writing
Looks up the contact and sends its _id string, not the email or an object
Shows a plain summary and waits for an explicit yes before the POST
Reads the ticket back by _id and reports it

evals.prompt: ¿Cuántos negocios se crearon entre el 1 y el 15 de este mes?
evals.expected_output: Answers in Spanish with a read-only count, using $and for the date range (or two separate conditions), never {$gte, $lte} on the same field.
expectations: The xquery puts the two date bounds in separate conditions inside $and
Reports pagination.count from the list response

evals.prompt: Add a 'Tax ID' field to companies.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the prolibu-custom-fields skill instead of writing a CustomField by hand.
expectations: Names prolibu-custom-fields as the skill for this and follows it
Does not POST to /v2/customfield through the generic helper

evals.prompt: Create a new API key for our integration and show me the existing ones.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to read or create Token records through a skill and tells the user to do it in the Prolibu app or ask an admin.
expectations: Explains in plain words that keys are managed in the app by an admin

evals.prompt: Mueve el negocio <deal> a la etapa Aprobado.
evals.expected_output: Routes to the prolibu-stages skill (stage moves have required fields and side effects) instead of a hand-made PATCH.
expectations: Names prolibu-stages as the skill for stage moves and follows it
Does not PATCH the deal's stage with the generic helper before reading the stage rules
